弱离子与 H⁺、OH⁻ · 正在看：① 盐溶液站: Weak ions with H⁺ and OH⁻ · viewing: ① salt solution station

五种盐溶液摆在这里，为什么非得用 pH 计一支一支量？: Five salt solutions are set out here. Why must we measure them one by one with a pH meter?
四站都在：① 试管架上 5 支 + 对照试管与一支 pH 计、② 酒精灯与水浴、: All four stations are here: ① 5 tubes + a control in the rack with a pH meter, ② spirit lamp and water bath, ③ three muddy-water tubes (one control), ④ the magnified box above the bench. Main reading: degree of hydrolysis 0 %, pH 7.00 (0.100 mol/L NaCl, neutral)
盐溶液 + 水 → 酸性、碱性还是中性？: Salt solution + water → acidic, basic or neutral?
四个站各回答一个不同的问题：盐的类型、温度、净水、机理。: Each of the four stations answers a different question: type of salt, temperature, water purification, mechanism.
5 支 + 对照并排、同高同光照，才看得出颜色与浑浊的差别。: Only with 5 tubes + a control side by side, at the same height and lighting, can differences in color and cloudiness be seen.
pH 计是本题唯一能把「酸碱性」变成数的仪器（量程 0–14）。: The pH meter is the only instrument here that turns "acidity" into a number (range 0–14).
去掉这一步：学生以为「盐 = 中性」，后面每一步都成了无源之水。: Skip this step and students assume "salt = neutral", leaving every later step without a foundation.
常考：为什么能用 pH 计区分盐溶液的酸碱性；pH 的读数是 c(H⁺) 的负对: Common exam point: why a pH meter can tell salt solutions' acidity apart; the pH reading is the negative logarithm of c(H⁺).
盐溶液不一定中性：同样是「盐」，有的显酸性、有的显碱性，得先量出来才知道。: Salt solutions are not necessarily neutral: some "salts" are acidic and some basic, and you only know after measuring.
换一种盐，pH 就变了——是盐的「出身」决定的吗？: Change the salt and the pH changes. Is it decided by the salt's "parentage"?
把「盐的种类」从 NaCl 拨到 NH₄Cl、CH₃COONa，看 pH 走哪边: Switch "type of salt" from NaCl to NH₄Cl and CH₃COONa and see which way the pH goes
NaCl 7.00（中性）→ NH₄Cl 5.12（酸性，水解度 0.0075: NaCl 7.00 (neutral) → NH₄Cl 5.12 (acidic, degree of hydrolysis 0.0075 %) → CH₃COONa 8.88 (basic, 0.0076 %) → Na₂CO₃ 11.65 (more strongly basic, 4.5 %) → FeCl₃ 1.65 (acidic, 22 %)
NaCl 中性 · NH₄Cl 酸性 · CH₃COONa 碱性: NaCl neutral · NH₄Cl acidic · CH₃COONa basic
判断酸碱性看的是「盐由哪种酸和哪种碱生成」。: To judge acidity, look at "which acid and which base the salt comes from".
NaCl、KNO₃ 的离子都不与 H⁺、OH⁻ 结合，所以呈中性。: The ions of NaCl and KNO₃ do not combine with H⁺ or OH⁻, so they are neutral.
Na₂CO₃ 的碱性比 CH₃COONa 强，因为 HCO₃⁻ 比 CH₃COO: Na₂CO₃ is more basic than CH₃COONa because HCO₃⁻ ionizes even less than CH₃COOH.
去掉这一步：学生会把盐按「含不含金属」分类，而不是按酸碱强弱分。: Skip this step and students classify salts by "contains a metal or not" instead of by the strength of the acid and base.
高频：给盐判酸碱性；「Na₂CO₃ 为什么被当作碱使用」。: Frequent: judge a salt's acidity; "why is Na₂CO₃ used as a base".
强酸强碱盐的溶液呈中性，强酸弱碱盐的溶液呈酸性，强碱弱酸盐的溶液呈碱性（教材原话: Solutions of salts of a strong acid and strong base are neutral, of a strong acid and weak base acidic, and of a strong base and weak acid basic (textbook wording).

NaCl 和 NH₄Cl 都是盐，凭什么一个中性一个酸性？: NaCl and NH₄Cl are both salts. Why is one neutral and the other acidic?
箱里满是 NH₄⁺ 与 Cl⁻，还有水自己电离出的一对 H⁺、OH⁻；NH₄⁺: The box is full of NH₄⁺ and Cl⁻, plus a pair of H⁺ and OH⁻ from water's own ionization; NH₄⁺ grabs OH⁻ to become NH₃·H₂O, leaving extra H⁺ → acidic. The degree of hydrolysis is only 0.0075 %, so the box can show just 1 hydrolysis product (magnified)
示意放大 · 1 个粒子 = 0.005 mmol · 正在看：① 盐溶液站: Magnified · 1 particle = 0.005 mmol · viewing: ① salt solution station
关键不是「盐里有 H⁺」，而是「弱离子把水的 H⁺ 或 OH⁻ 抢走了」。: The key is not "the salt contains H⁺", but "the weak ion takes H⁺ or OH⁻ from water".
被抢走的是 OH⁻，水的电离平衡就往右补，于是 H⁺ 多出来。: When OH⁻ is taken, water's ionization equilibrium shifts right to make up, so H⁺ ends up in excess.
强碱弱酸盐反过来：CO₃²⁻ 抢 H⁺，OH⁻ 多出来。: Salts of a strong base and weak acid work the other way: CO₃²⁻ takes H⁺, leaving excess OH⁻.
去掉这一步：学生只会背「强酸弱碱盐显酸性」，说不出为什么。: Skip this step and students can only recite "salts of a strong acid and weak base are acidic" without saying why.
微观解释题：写出 NH₄Cl 水解的离子方程式，并说明 c(H⁺) > c(OH: Microscopic explanation question: write the ionic equation for NH₄Cl hydrolysis and explain why c(H⁺) > c(OH⁻).
NH₄⁺ 与水电离出的 OH⁻ 结合生成弱电解质 NH₃·H₂O，破坏了水的电离: NH₄⁺ combines with OH⁻ from water's ionization to form the weak electrolyte NH₃·H₂O, upsetting water's ionization equilibrium and shifting it right, so c(H⁺) > c(OH⁻) (textbook wording).
加水稀释，水解程度变大还是变小？: Does diluting with water increase or decrease the extent of hydrolysis?
把 CH₃COONa 的浓度从 0.100 稀释到 0.010 mol/L，同时: Dilute CH₃COONa from 0.100 to 0.010 mol/L while watching the degree of hydrolysis and the pH
CH₃COONa 由 0.100 稀释到 0.010 mol/L：水解度 0.0: Diluting CH₃COONa from 0.100 to 0.010 mol/L: degree of hydrolysis 0.0076 % → 0.024 % (larger), but pH 8.88 → 8.38 and the concentration of hydrolyzed weak ions 7.6×10⁻⁶ → 2.4×10⁻⁶ (smaller)
稀释时「水解度」和「离子浓度」朝相反方向走，这是本题最容易混的一处。: On dilution the "degree of hydrolysis" and the "ion concentration" move in opposite directions, the easiest point to confuse in this topic.
判断水解程度看水解度，判断酸碱性看 c(H⁺) 或 c(OH⁻)。: Judge the extent of hydrolysis by the degree of hydrolysis, and acidity by c(H⁺) or c(OH⁻).
所以「稀释促进水解」不能读成「稀释后碱性更强」。: So "dilution promotes hydrolysis" must not be read as "more basic after dilution".
去掉这一步：学生把两个量当成同一个量，选择题一半会错。: Skip this step and students treat the two quantities as one, getting half the multiple-choice questions wrong.
高频：稀释对水解程度与 c(H⁺) 的影响方向相反。: Frequent: dilution affects the extent of hydrolysis and c(H⁺) in opposite directions.
加水稀释促使平衡向水解方向移动、水解程度增大；但溶液变稀，c(OH⁻) 反而减小: Diluting with water shifts the equilibrium toward hydrolysis and increases its extent; but the solution is more dilute, so c(OH⁻) actually falls and it is less basic.
A4.5、B2.1 标准值表 3/7/8、D3: A4.5, B2.1 standard values table 3/7/8, D3
把纯碱水加热，为什么洗油污更干净？: Why does hot soda water remove grease better?
把 Na₂CO₃ 溶液从 25 ℃ 加热到 100 ℃，盯住被水解的弱离子浓度与: Heat the Na₂CO₃ solution from 25 ℃ to 100 ℃, watching the concentration of hydrolyzed weak ions and the degree of hydrolysis
Na₂CO₃ 0.100 mol/L：25 ℃ 被水解的弱离子浓度 4.5×10: Na₂CO₃ 0.100 mol/L: hydrolyzed weak ion concentration 4.5×10⁻³ at 25 ℃ with 4.5 % hydrolysis → 3.7×10⁻² at 100 ℃ (8 times larger) with 37 %; the heated greasy tube is clearly cleaner. No pH value is given in this step (room-temperature basis only)
水解吸热 = 中和热的逆反应 · 25 → 100 ℃: Hydrolysis is endothermic = the reverse of neutralization · 25 → 100 ℃
升温是「所有水解」的促进因素，不分酸式盐还是碱式盐。: Heating promotes "all hydrolysis", whether the salt gives an acidic or a basic solution.
油污水浴那两支试管一支加热一支不加热，就是教材的对照。: Of the two greasy tubes in the water bath, one heated and one not: that is the textbook's control.
热的纯碱更「碱」，靠的是 c(OH⁻) 增大，不是温度本身。: Hot soda is "more basic" because c(OH⁻) rises, not because of the temperature itself.
去掉这一步：学生只会背「升温促进水解」，说不出为什么能洗得更干净。: Skip this step and students only recite "heating promotes hydrolysis" without saying why it cleans better.
高频：升温为什么促进水解（水解吸热）；去油污为什么加热。: Frequent: why heating promotes hydrolysis (hydrolysis is endothermic); why grease removal uses heat.
盐类水解是吸热反应（中和反应的逆反应），加热促使平衡向水解方向移动、水解程度增大: Salt hydrolysis is endothermic (the reverse of neutralization); heating shifts the equilibrium toward hydrolysis and increases its extent, so c(OH⁻) rises and hot soda water removes grease better.
A4.5、A4.6、B2.1 标准值表 4/10、D2、D8: A4.5, A4.6, B2.1 standard values table 4/10, D2, D8
较浓盐酸为什么能把 Fe³⁺ 的水解压下去？: Why can fairly concentrated hydrochloric acid hold back the hydrolysis of Fe³⁺?
往 0.010 mol/L FeCl₃ 里加盐酸到折算 0.060 mol/L，: Add hydrochloric acid to 0.010 mol/L FeCl₃ up to an equivalent 0.060 mol/L, watching the degree of hydrolysis and the color
FeCl₃ 0.010 mol/L：加酸 0 → 0.060 mol/L，水解度: FeCl₃ 0.010 mol/L: acid 0 → 0.060 mol/L, degree of hydrolysis 54 % → 9.4 %, color clearly lighter (still clear); pH 2.27 → 1.22. Conversely, adding acid to CH₃COONa raises the fraction of CH₃COO⁻ converted from 0.0076 % to 20 % (promoted)
加酸的结果要分盐：酸式盐被抑制，碱式盐被促进。: The effect of adding acid depends on the salt: acidic salts are suppressed, basic salts promoted.
CH₃COONa 那一支看的是「CH₃COO⁻ 转化的比例」——H⁺ 是被直接加: For CH₃COONa we look at "the fraction of CH₃COO⁻ converted": H⁺ added directly consumes OH⁻ and CH₃COO⁻, rather than the reversible hydrolysis itself growing.
抑制 Fe³⁺ 水解的代价是溶液更酸，所以配溶液只能先加酸再稀释。: The price of suppressing Fe³⁺ hydrolysis is a more acidic solution, so the solution can only be prepared by adding acid first, then diluting.
去掉这一步：学生把「加酸一定抑制水解」当通则，碱式盐那一问必错。: Skip this step and students treat "adding acid always suppresses hydrolysis" as a rule and get the basic salt question wrong.
高频：配制 FeCl₃、Fe₂(SO₄)₃ 溶液为什么先加酸；加酸对两类盐方向相: Frequent: why FeCl₃ and Fe₂(SO₄)₃ solutions are prepared with acid first; acid affects the two types of salt in opposite directions.
增大 c(H⁺) 使水解平衡向逆方向移动、抑制 Fe³⁺ 水解；所以实验室配制: Raising c(H⁺) shifts the hydrolysis equilibrium backward and suppresses Fe³⁺ hydrolysis; so in the lab FeCl₃ crystals are first dissolved in fairly concentrated hydrochloric acid and then diluted.
A4.7、A4.5、B2.1 标准值表 12–17、D4、D5: A4.7, A4.5, B2.1 standard values table 12–17, D4, D5
两勺泥水加点铁盐、铝盐，凭什么能变清？: Two spoonfuls of muddy water with a bit of iron or aluminum salt: how can it turn clear?
往浑浊水里加入 2 mL 净水剂，看三支试管（含对照）谁先澄清；再拨「净水剂种类: Add 2 mL of coagulant to the muddy water and see which of the three tubes (including the control) clears first; then switch "coagulant type" to the aluminum salt
加净水剂前浊度 100，加入后降到 15（示意）：Fe³⁺、Al³⁺ 水解生成的: Turbidity 100 before adding coagulant, 15 after (illustrative): colloids from Fe³⁺ and Al³⁺ hydrolysis gather fine suspended particles into larger ones that settle. Switching to Al₂(SO₄)₃ works just as well, only the colloid is white instead of brownish red
5 mL 浑浊水 + 2 mL 净水剂 · 静置 5 min: 5 mL muddy water + 2 mL coagulant · stand 5 min
起作用的是「水解生成的胶体」，不是离子本身。: What works is "the colloid formed by hydrolysis", not the ions themselves.
三支试管必有一支不加净水剂作对照，否则看不出澄清是净水剂带来的。: One of the three tubes must have no coagulant as a control, or you cannot tell the clearing comes from the coagulant.
明矾 KAl(SO₄)₂·12H₂O 与 FeCl₃ 是同一原理，教材练习第 1: Alum KAl(SO₄)₂·12H₂O works on the same principle as FeCl₃; textbook exercise 1 tests exactly this.
去掉这一步：学生把净水剂当成消毒剂，答不到「胶体吸附」。: Skip this step and students mistake coagulants for disinfectants, missing "colloid adsorption".
高频：净水剂为什么能净水（胶体吸附聚沉）；明矾溶液显酸性的原因。: Frequent: why coagulants purify water (colloid adsorption and coagulation); why alum solution is acidic.
可溶性的铝盐、铁盐靠水解生成的胶体吸附悬浮颗粒而净水，不是杀菌消毒。: Soluble aluminum and iron salts purify water because the colloids formed by hydrolysis adsorb suspended particles; they do not kill germs.
A4.8、A5.3、A3.2 步骤2、B2.1 算子 6、D7: A4.8, A5.3, A3.2 step 2, B2.1 operator 6, D7
煮沸 FeCl₃ 溶液会变红褐色，可蒸干它为什么又得不到 FeCl₃？: Boiling FeCl₃ solution turns it red-brown. Why can't you get FeCl₃ back by evaporating it to dryness?
把 0.010 mol/L FeCl₃ 煮沸，看液色怎么变成红褐色（胶体），再想: Boil 0.010 mol/L FeCl₃ and watch the color turn red-brown (colloid), then think about what would be left after evaporating to dryness
FeCl₃ 0.010 mol/L：25 ℃ 水解度 54 %、溶液澄清（黄棕色: FeCl₃ 0.010 mol/L: at 25 ℃ hydrolysis is 54 % and the solution is clear (yellow-brown, pH 2.27) → at 100 ℃ it is 99 % and the liquid turns red-brown (Fe(OH)₃ colloid, transparent, with the Tyndall effect, not cloudy); evaporating to dryness and heating strongly leaves Fe₂O₃, not FeCl₃
Fe³⁺ + 3H₂O ⇌ Fe(OH)₃ + 3H⁺（HCl 挥发，平衡右移）: Fe³⁺ + 3H₂O ⇌ Fe(OH)₃ + 3H⁺ (HCl escapes, equilibrium shifts right)
这是本课的错误操作示范：想用蒸干的办法拿到 FeCl₃，实际拿到的是 Fe(OH: This is the lesson's demonstration of a wrong procedure: trying to get FeCl₃ by evaporating to dryness actually gives Fe(OH)₃, which then decomposes to Fe₂O₃.
错在哪一步：HCl 是水解产物，一挥发就不再是可逆平衡，水解被「抽干」。: Where it goes wrong: HCl is a hydrolysis product, and once it escapes the equilibrium is no longer reversible, so hydrolysis is "drained dry".
胶体是红褐色透明的（丁达尔效应可验证），与泥水那种浑浊不是一回事。: The colloid is red-brown and transparent (check with the Tyndall effect), not the same as cloudy muddy water.
去掉这一步：学生记住「加热促进水解」，却不知道推到极端会发生什么。: Skip this step and students remember "heating promotes hydrolysis" without knowing what happens when it is pushed to the extreme.
高频：AlCl₃、FeCl₃ 溶液蒸干灼烧的产物；为什么得不到无水盐。: Frequent: the products of evaporating AlCl₃ or FeCl₃ solution to dryness and heating; why the anhydrous salt cannot be obtained.
加热使水解趋于完全，HCl 又随蒸气挥发，平衡一直向右移；所以蒸干、灼烧得不到: Heating drives hydrolysis toward completion while HCl escapes with the vapor, so the equilibrium keeps shifting right; evaporating and heating strongly cannot give FeCl₃.

FeCl₃ 0.010 mol/L、温度 ≤ 30 ℃，把水解度压到 ≤ 10: FeCl₃ 0.010 mol/L, temperature ≤ 30 ℃, hold the degree of hydrolysis at ≤ 10 % for 15 s; partway through the temperature will be raised to 60 ℃
达标横幅「盐类水解 · 配溶液达标」；进入 5 s 后温度被抬到 60 ℃（水解: Pass banner "Salt hydrolysis · solution prepared"; 5 s in the temperature is raised to 60 ℃ (hydrolysis 49 %, out of range), and you must drag the temperature back to 25 ℃ or add more acid to bring it back within 10 %
加酸是主手段：0.070 mol/L 的盐酸把水解度从 54 % 压到 8.2: Adding acid is the main tool: 0.070 mol/L hydrochloric acid brings hydrolysis from 54 % down to 8.2 %.
温度是敌人：一加热就回到 49 %，比加酸的效果还快。: Temperature is the enemy: as soon as it is heated, hydrolysis is back to 49 %, faster than the acid can act.
浓度按教材 0.010 mol/L，不能靠稀释蒙过去。: The concentration follows the textbook's 0.010 mol/L; you cannot get by through dilution.

考核没有新结论：把「先溶于较浓盐酸、再稀释、不加热」三件事同时照顾好，水解度才压: The check has no new conclusion: only by handling "dissolve in fairly concentrated hydrochloric acid first, then dilute, no heating" at once can hydrolysis be held down.

本班目标：按教材配 0.010 mol/L FeCl₃ 溶液——先加盐酸抑制水解: Class goal: prepare 0.010 mol/L FeCl₃ solution per the textbook: add hydrochloric acid first to suppress hydrolysis, temperature ≤ 30 ℃, degree of hydrolysis ≤ 10 %, held for 15 s
下列盐溶液中，因盐类水解而呈酸性的是: Which of these salt solutions is acidic because of salt hydrolysis?
NH₄⁺ 水解生成 NH₃·H₂O 和 H⁺，溶液呈酸性；CH₃COOH 本身是: NH₄⁺ hydrolyzes to NH₃·H₂O and H⁺, so the solution is acidic; CH₃COOH is itself an acid, not a salt; Na₂SO₄ does not hydrolyze; NaHCO₃ hydrolyzes to give a basic solution.
用 Na₂CO₃ 溶液清洗油污时，加热能增强去污效果，原因是: When cleaning grease with Na₂CO₃ solution, heating improves the cleaning because
温度升高使油脂溶解得更快，与水解无关: Higher temperature makes the grease dissolve faster, unrelated to hydrolysis
升温促进 CO₃²⁻ 的水解，使 c(OH⁻) 增大: Heating promotes the hydrolysis of CO₃²⁻, increasing c(OH⁻)
升温使水的离子积变小，c(OH⁻) 增大: Heating makes the ionic product of water smaller, increasing c(OH⁻)
盐类水解吸热，升温使 CO₃²⁻ + H₂O ⇌ HCO₃⁻ + OH⁻ 右移，: Salt hydrolysis is endothermic, so heating shifts CO₃²⁻ + H₂O ⇌ HCO₃⁻ + OH⁻ right, c(OH⁻) rises and cleaning is stronger. This lesson calculated it: 0.100 mol/L Na₂CO₃ goes from 4.5×10⁻³ at 25 ℃ to 3.7×10⁻² at 100 ℃.
把 0.100 mol/L CH₃COONa 溶液加水稀释到 0.010 mol: Diluting 0.100 mol/L CH₃COONa solution with water to 0.010 mol/L, which statement is correct?
水解程度增大，溶液的碱性增强: The extent of hydrolysis increases and the solution becomes more basic
水解程度增大，但 c(OH⁻) 减小: The extent of hydrolysis increases, but c(OH⁻) decreases
水解程度减小，c(OH⁻) 增大: The extent of hydrolysis decreases and c(OH⁻) increases
水解程度与 c(OH⁻) 都不变: Neither the extent of hydrolysis nor c(OH⁻) changes
稀释促使水解平衡右移，水解度由 0.0076 % 增大到 0.024 %；但溶液: Dilution shifts the hydrolysis equilibrium right, raising the degree of hydrolysis from 0.0076 % to 0.024 %; but the solution is more dilute, so c(OH⁻) falls from 7.6×10⁻⁶ to 2.4×10⁻⁶ and it is less basic.
实验室配制 FeCl₃ 溶液时，常把 FeCl₃ 晶体先溶于较浓的盐酸再稀释，目: When preparing FeCl₃ solution in the lab, the crystals are usually first dissolved in fairly concentrated hydrochloric acid, then diluted, in order to
增大 c(H⁺)，抑制 Fe³⁺ 水解: Raise c(H⁺) and suppress Fe³⁺ hydrolysis
增大 c(Cl⁻)，抑制 Fe³⁺ 水解: Raise c(Cl⁻) and suppress Fe³⁺ hydrolysis
增大 c(OH⁻)，促进 Fe³⁺ 水解: Raise c(OH⁻) and promote Fe³⁺ hydrolysis
H⁺ 是 Fe³⁺ 水解的产物，增大 c(H⁺) 使平衡左移，抑制水解、防止溶液: H⁺ is a product of Fe³⁺ hydrolysis, so raising c(H⁺) shifts the equilibrium left, suppressing hydrolysis and keeping the solution from turning cloudy. This lesson calculated it: adding acid to 0.060 mol/L brings the hydrolysis of 0.010 mol/L FeCl₃ down from 54 % to 9.4 %.
把 FeCl₃ 溶液蒸干并灼烧，最后得到的主要固体是: Evaporating FeCl₃ solution to dryness and heating strongly, the main solid finally obtained is
加热使水解趋于完全，HCl 随蒸气挥发，平衡不断右移，最后得到 Fe(OH)₃；: Heating drives hydrolysis toward completion and HCl escapes with the vapor, so the equilibrium keeps shifting right, finally giving Fe(OH)₃, which decomposes to Fe₂O₃ on strong heating. So the anhydrous salt can only be obtained by heating off the water in an HCl atmosphere.
可溶性的铝盐、铁盐能净水，其原因是: Soluble aluminum and iron salts can purify water because
Al³⁺、Fe³⁺ 水解生成的胶体使悬浮颗粒聚集沉降: The colloids formed by Al³⁺ and Fe³⁺ hydrolysis make suspended particles gather and settle
Al³⁺、Fe³⁺ 与泥沙发生中和反应: Al³⁺ and Fe³⁺ neutralize the mud and sand
铝盐、铁盐能增大水的密度，使泥沙下沉: Aluminum and iron salts increase the density of water, making the mud sink
教材原话：Al³⁺ 水解生成的 Al(OH)₃ 胶体、Fe³⁺ 水解生成的 Fe: Textbook wording: the Al(OH)₃ colloid from Al³⁺ hydrolysis and the Fe(OH)₃ colloid from Fe³⁺ hydrolysis can gather fine suspended particles in water into larger ones that settle. It is not disinfection.
已加入 2 mL 净水剂：胶体把悬浮颗粒聚沉，浊度 100 → 15: 2 mL coagulant added: the colloid coagulates the suspended particles, turbidity 100 → 15
未加净水剂（对照管）：泥水依旧浑浊，浊度 100: No coagulant (control tube): the muddy water stays cloudy, turbidity 100
净水剂换成 1 mol/L Al₂(SO₄)₃：同样有效，胶体由棕红变白: Coagulant switched to 1 mol/L Al₂(SO₄)₃: just as effective, the colloid turns from brownish red to white
净水剂为饱和 FeCl₃：解得红褐色 Fe(OH)₃ 胶体: Coagulant is saturated FeCl₃: it hydrolyzes to a red-brown Fe(OH)₃ colloid
异常：温度被抬到 60 ℃——水解度跳到 49 %，先把它拖回 25 ℃: Fault: the temperature was raised to 60 ℃ and hydrolysis jumped to 49 %; drag it back to 25 ℃ first
